omnibus Fidei Articulis Tractatio; Vix alia tamen
miserrimo hoc seculo Disputationum feracissimo, in
Controversiis, quæ Nobis cum Adversariis interce-
dunt, momentosior, magisque necessaria videtur Dis-
putatione de Ecclesia, quam nunc sub divinis auspi-
ciis exequendam suscipimus.
II. Quamvis enim Controversiæ de Ecclesia non sint ex primis, quæ
Secessioni nostræ ab Ecclesia Romana locum dederunt, sed tantum ex se-
cundariis, quæ ex aliis ortæ sunt, quatenus Pontificii diffisi causæ suæ bo-
nitati in aliis doctrinæ capitibus, sese receperunt ad Ecclesiæ autoritatem,
ut sub ejus clypeo tutius laterent; Progressu tamen temporis factæ sunt
principales, in quibus Adversarii proram & puppim causæ suæ videntur
collocare. Unde multiplex Disquisitionis istius oritur necessitas; sive
absolutè & in se spectetur, sive relatè ad Adversarios.

page.notes: Top right "Pag. I" and foot "3" both transcribed in page_number; the foot line "Pars III." was put in running_head although it sits at the foot. Woodcut borders and ornaments not transcribed. The catchword "ciús" is hard to read; the next page begins "ciis", so the [?] marks a doubtful reading. The subtitle is printed with a line-end hyphen in "co-gnitio" and a space before "?", both kept as printed. Long s is written as plain s throughout. The first word is set in small capitals after a woodcut initial, transcribed as "CUm".
